topics.name: Command Parse and Resolution
topics.purpose: Define deterministic parse and exact command-tree resolution before argument validation or execution.

semantics.exact_rule: Resolution requires an exact concrete command or explicit alias match.
semantics.family_rule: Stopping on a non-executable family returns help/error rather than guessing a descendant.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown command never falls back to fuzzy nearest match for execution.
semantics.argument_rule: Unknown/invalid options fail according to exact command schema.
semantics.context_rule: Targets/context are explicit and not inferred from hidden UI/cwd unless the command contract explicitly defines them.
semantics.inert_rule: Successful parse creates inert invocation data only.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.
